verdict.rationale: ADK's own docs say agents can swap their underlying model across Google and other providers through adapters, including locally running models. The agent definition exposes the model as a single parameter, which implies a swap does not require rewriting agent logic. missing for 10: documentation of specific adapters and provider configuration, an explicit example of changing providers without code changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent

citations.quote: ADK can work with almost any generative AI model. The framework provides easy access to Gemini as well as other leading models, and we provide adapters that let you connect with many other models and model providers, including locally running models.
Swap the underlying intelligence of your agents by integrating with generative AI models from Google and other providers.
